description.text:
The deck that won the 15 and up division of the 2006 World Championships. From its second turn, Manectric ex's Disconnect attack limits the Trainer cards the opponent can play, and Mew ex copies attacks in play. The 2006 World Championships were held at the Hilton Anaheim in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2006.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2006 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
